get.description:
**Purpose:**

This allows you to view details such as the subscription ID, URL, subscribed events, and active status for each webhook. Use this endpoint to manage and monitor your webhook subscriptions.

**Content-Type**: multipart/form-data.

delete.description:
**Purpose:**

This endpoint is used to permanently delete an existing webhook subscription. Once deleted, the system will no longer send event notifications to the associated URL. Use this endpoint when the webhook is no longer needed.

**Content-Type**: multipart/form-data.
